request: Analyze GSE185530 for PMID 35850762 (Long non-coding RNA Tug1 modulates mitochondrial and myogenic responses to exercise in skeletal muscle.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.
decision_maker: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) Claude Code subagent session

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq, poly-A stranded, NovaSeq 6000, C2C12 mouse myotubes (S5.8.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Transcriptional response of control-LNA C2C12 myotubes to in-vitro simulated exercise (3 h electrical pulse stimulation), immediately after (EPS 0h) and after 3 h recovery (EPS 3h), each versus Rest (S2.5.p2, FIG7)
final.sample_inclusion: 36 libraries = 2 LNA x 3 EPS conditions x 6 (triplicate wells from two independent experiments) (S5.8.p1, FIG7 legend)
planned_contrasts: Control EPS 0h vs Control Rest (S2.5.p2; paper: 835 genes UP, log2FC>1, FDR<0.01)
Control EPS 3h vs Control Rest (S2.5.p2; paper: 1316 genes UP, log2FC>1, FDR<0.01)
Tug1 KD vs Control at Rest (S2.5.p1; 867 DEGs FDR<0.01) - not an exercise contrast, out of scope
EPS response in Tug1 KD vs control (FIG7E/F, blunted/augmented genes) - modulation of the exercise response, exploratory here
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; each library is one well (independent cultures); wells come from two independent experiments (S5.8.p1)
final.normalization: Degust voom/limma; genes with >=1 RPM in >=12 of 36 libraries (S5.8.p2)
final.paper_method: limma-voom in Degust v4.1.5 on the 36 libraries (S5.8.p2)

paper_results.genes: Hspa1a, Atf3, Nr4a3 up at EPS 0h; Gabpa up with EPS; Nrf1/Tfam not up; Ppargc1a not DE at FDR 0.05 (S2.5.p2, S2.5.p4)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Exercise question = EPS vs Rest within control-LNA myotubes, the counts the paper reports in S2.5.p2. Threshold stated there: log2FC>1, FDR<0.01, upregulated genes only. FIG7 legend says FDR<0.001 for the volcano colouring and methods (S5.8.p2) give a general FDR<0.05; the text rule matches the reported counts, so it is used. KD-at-rest (867 DEGs) is not an exercise estimand.

checks: GEO metadata: C2C12 myotubes, LNA Negative control/Tug1 x EPS Rest/EPS 0h/EPS 3h, 6 per cell, 36 total = paper's 36 libraries
matrix has 36 count columns AT19-AT54 matching metadata description field

ownership.reasoning: Data availability statement S11.p1 cites GSE185530; sample structure matches S5.8.p1/S5.8.p2 (36 libraries).

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (AT19..AT54) equal metadata 'description' exactly (inspect alignment_keys 36/36). grp combines LNA and EPS into six cells. exp (E1 = rep 1-3, E2 = rep 4-6) is an INFERRED experiment label from replicate numbering and library order (AT19-36 then AT37-54); used only in a sensitivity model.

matrix.reasoning: File named raw_gene_counts_matrix; all values integers 0..386893, median 0 over 55,416 Ensembl genes; data_processing: STAR 2-pass alignment with gene-level quantification; paper analysed with voom which takes raw counts (S5.8.p2).

final.analysis_type: multi-group (6 cells, 2 LNA x 3 EPS); planned contrasts within control LNA

candidates.value: pool LNA arms for EPS vs Rest
candidates.reason_rejected: paper's EPS counts are within control myotubes (S2.5.p2); Tug1 KD changes the EPS response

candidates.value: Tug1 KD vs control at Rest

design.reasoning: Paper reports EPS 0h and EPS 3h vs Rest in control myotubes (S2.5.p2). One control level with two time points -> planned contrasts against the same Rest reference, never pooled. The EPS response in Tug1 KD myotubes is shown in FIG7E/F; run as exploratory.

covariates.disposition: excluded: experiment label inferred from replicate numbering, not documented in GEO; paper (Degust) did not adjust; balanced 3+3 in every cell; tested in a DESeq2 sensitivity model

covariance.reasoning: Each library is a separate well; no subject pairing. Two independent experiments (S5.8.p1) are balanced across all six cells, so they cannot confound EPS; the paper did not block.

paper_route.method: limma-voom in Degust 4.1.5, TMM, one model on 36 libraries
paper_route.reason: repository voom executor fits only the two contrast arms and uses colSums library sizes (no TMM; tools/limma_voom.R header); no multi-group voom executor exists

deviations: voom fitted per contrast on 12 samples instead of one 36-sample model (variance pooled over 12 samples)
low-count filter applied as in the paper (>=1 CPM in >=12 of 36 libraries) on all 36 samples before subsetting

method.reasoning: Paper used voom on raw counts (S5.8.p2); raw counts allow it, so the paper's method family is reproduced with declared executor deviations. DESeq2 joint model on all 36 samples (with and without exp) runs as sensitivity.

final.deviation_note: Paper counts only upregulated genes; compare with our 'up' count. Audit = methods' general FDR<0.05 (S5.8.p2).

threshold.reasoning: S2.5.p2: 'log2FC>1, FDR<0.01' for the EPS counts.

caveats: paper counts are upregulated genes only
